name: Amin al-Husseini
contribution: A Palestinian Arab nationalist and Muslim leader in Mandatory Palestine.
image_credit: American Colony (Jerusalem), Photo Dept., photographer · Public domain

checks.lead: Mohammed Amin al-Husseini (Arabic: محمد أمين الحسيني; c. 1897 – 4 July 1974) was a Palestinian Arab nationalist and Muslim leader in Mandatory Palestine. He was the scion of the al-Husayni family of Jerusalemite Arab nobles, who trace their origins to the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
